workload.note: Career highs in receptions and yards; Pro Bowl; led team with 38 more catches than 2nd-leading pass catcher.

contract.note: 4-year, $140M extension with $108M guaranteed, ties him as 4th-highest-paid WR at $35M AAV (matching Justin Jefferson). Deal replaces his 2027 fifth-year rookie option (which Baltimore had exercised in April). Signals Ravens see him as standalone WR1 / Lamar Jackson's primary target going forward.

scheme.note: Major offensive coaching turnover for 2026: Ravens fired HC John Harbaugh after missing playoffs; hired Jesse Minter (ex-Chargers DC) as new HC. Prior OC Todd Monken left to become Cleveland Browns HC (hired 2026-01-28). New Ravens OC for 2026 is Declan Doyle (previously with Bears in 2025), per Baltimore Beatdown coaching tracker. New WR coach: Keary Colbert (previously Broncos 2023-2025).

notes: Set career highs across the board in 2025 (86 rec, 1,211 yds) under since-departed OC Todd Monken; new OC Declan Doyle and new HC Jesse Minter represent an unproven scheme change for 2026.
